title: Inverse functions, symmetry and transformations
intro: Read this before the inverse and transformation questions.

blocks.title: inverse
blocks.body: $f^{-1}$ undoes $f$. It exists only if $f$ is one-to-one (passes the horizontal line test). To find it: write $y=f(x)$, swap the roles, solve for $x$.

blocks.title: the slips
items: Changes inside the brackets act on $x$ and work backwards.
